summary: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $1.045 billion Term Loan Credit Agreement to finance the closing of an acquisition (the Transactions) on June 12, 2026, along with fees and expenses. The agreement also allows an additional uncommitted draw of up to $95 million to partially fund the previously announced acquisition of LaCorium Health, expected to close in Q2 fiscal 2027. Term loans bear interest at Term SOFR plus 2.00% or an alternate base rate. No price-per-share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing references a prior acquisition announcement; the deal is partially debt-funded with a second draw mechanism for LaCorium. Watch for closing of the LaCorium acquisition and integration risk.
